description: Get detailed information about a specific YouTuber by their YouTube channel ID. Includes llmDescription and llmSponsorProfile (LLM-friendly summaries), lastAnalyzedAt (when sponsors were last detected on the channel — every channel is re-scanned weekly; use youtuber_refresh if it is older than 7 days and you need fresher data), and lastFullAnalysisAt (last full-history analysis; null if never — see youtuber_fullAnalysis).
name: youtuber_get
